summary: Frontend visual upgrade validation (iteration_9) for Punto Cero One HOME. All 6 primary slides now render with cinematographic Unsplash background images + per-slide gradient overlays (community, vision, ecosystem, legal, latam, evolution). Welcome bar (feed-welcome-bar) with pulsing green dot appears between primary slider and FeedComposer with correct copy. Right-widgets reclassification is applied: 'Empresas del ecosistema' contains only Punto Cero Legal (tag 'Legal · vertical') and Capital has been moved to a separate 'Investor Center' widget with 'Strategic growth · institucional' tag. Team secondary slider (pc-slider-team) has 3 dots (founders/people/careers), founders slide shows Darwin+Jonathan. Slide 4 LIVE badge and Slide 5 6+12 country chips still present. Regression: /capital 200, /join has all 5 social buttons, /investor-pitch-deck has 'Descargar PDF'. 0 horizontal overflow at 1440 and 375, welcome bar visible at 375. 0 console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PrimarySlides.jsx grew to ~540 LOC with the new image/overlay per slide — still readable but ripe for splitting each SlideN into its own module (./slides/SlideNCommunity.jsx, etc.) if any more visual layers are added.

SlideCarousel.pc-slide-inner now uses overflow: hidden auto — good for the tall founders slider, but it introduces a nested scrollbar; consider hiding the WebKit scrollbar visually (scrollbar-width: none) so the slider retains a cinematic look.

Unsplash images are loaded via direct URL with query params (w=1600). Consider lazy-loading (loading='lazy' on ) or pre-connect hints — currently they render as CSS background-image so no lazy-load; acceptable for hero but eventually move to with srcset for retina.
Welcome bar animation is defined inline with a <style> tag inside the component; if the component is rendered multiple times it would inject duplicate @keyframes — extract into App.css or index.css.

RightWidgets.jsx now has two separate Widget cards for Legal (as vertical) and Capital (as Investor Center) — good separation. CompanyRow could accept an icon prop so Capital doesn't render the generic '0' avatar identical to Legal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_9 acceptance items verified via Playwright: (a) Each of the 6 pc-slider-primary slides has a real Unsplash background-image with the expected per-slide overlay (community photo-1552664730, vision 1451187580, ecosystem 1518770660, legal 1589829545 for justice/legal, latam 1512453979 skyline, evolution 1517245386). Text unchanged from iteration_8. (b) LIVE EN PRODUCCIÓN badge visible on Slide 4. (c) All 6 top country chips + 12 secondary chips present on Slide 5. (d) feed-welcome-bar renders with exact text 'Bienvenido a la comunidad' + subtitle 'Publica tu primer punto cero y conecta con el ecosistema'. (e) Right-side widgets sequence verified: Empresas widget contains ONLY Punto Cero Legal + tag 'Legal · vertical' (Capital NOT leaked); Investor Center widget separately lists Punto Cero · Capital + tag 'Strategic growth · institucional'. (f) pc-slider-team present with 3 dots; dot-0 founders slide renders both Darwin and Jonathan. (g) 1440 and 375 both have scrollWidth === clientWidth (0 horizontal overflow). (h) Regression routes /capital, /join (5 social testids: join-google/linkedin/facebook/apple/microsoft), /investor-pitch-deck all load and have expected elements ('Descargar PDF' button visible on pitch deck). 0 pageerror events captured across HOME + Capital + Pitch Deck.
